About GoldAlert

GoldAlert is a free, independent research dashboard for tracking pullback signals across gold, silver, copper, platinum and oil markets.

What GoldAlert Does

The core idea behind GoldAlert is simple: when precious metals prices fall for 3 or 5 consecutive days, that pullback may represent a buying opportunity. Instead of presenting an unexplained black-box recommendation, GoldAlert makes this rule visible, testable, and transparent.

The simulator brings together spot gold (XAU/USD), silver (XAG/USD), mining shares, exchange-traded funds, and gold-backed digital assets on a single dashboard. Users can switch between a 3-day and 5-day consecutive decline signal to match their investment style and risk tolerance.

What We Track

  • Gold (XAU/USD) — Spot price and Antam (Indonesian gold) price signals
  • Silver (XAG/USD) — Spot price pullback simulator
  • Copper — Industrial metal trend tracking
  • Platinum — Precious metal ratio and signal data
  • Oil (WTI/Brent) — Macro commodity context
  • Natural Gas — Energy commodity signals
  • Gold/Silver Ratio — A classic macro indicator for metals
  • Bitcoin/Gold Ratio — Crypto-vs-gold store-of-value comparison

Data Sources

Live charts are powered by TradingView. Daily price data used for signal calculations is sourced from Yahoo Finance and CoinGecko. All data comes from third-party providers and may be subject to delays. GoldAlert does not guarantee the accuracy, completeness or timeliness of any market data displayed.

Who We Are

GoldAlert is an independent, non-commercial project built for retail investors and market enthusiasts who want a simple, honest tool to visualize commodity pullback signals. We do not hold customer funds, execute trades, provide broker services, or offer individualized investment advice of any kind.

All content on GoldAlert — including articles, signal displays and ratio tools — is provided for general educational and informational purposes only. Please see our Financial Disclaimer and Signal Methodology for full details.
